body:
sanjay: Heads-up — our DC in FRA hit a gate delay, vendor says 14-day ETA slip on the GPU topoff. We have 28 units pending, 4 flagged DOA on arrival. Need routing & RMA plan.
vendor-liaison: Sorry, on our side the forwarder reported customs hold + extra inspection. ETA moved to ~14 days. We can split the shipment: 20 immediate air replacements, 8 sea top-up. Air adds ~$1200/unit.
anika: Can vendor confirm which 4 are DOA serials? we need serials for RMA and warranty claim (vendor requires device-level).
vendor-liaison: Yes — RMA ticket 2026-778. Serial list below:
```
SN-A1B2C3D4
SN-A1B2C3D5
SN-A1B2C3D6
SN-A1B2C3D7
```
vendor-liaison: We can pre-authorize credit for DOA units pending depot photos. Propose 80% credit now, 20% after depot inspection.
josh: 80% sounds ok short-term but ops wants 100% pre-authorize for customer-critical lanes. Any wiggle on vendor side?
vendor-liaison: We can do 90% pre-authorize if Redwood covers AWB expedite for replaced units.
maria: Quick cost calc: 20 air replacements @+$1200 = +$24k, vendor credit 90% on 4 units (unit cost 60k) => vendor covers $216k now, Redwood fronting $24k expedite. Ops budget can absorb up to $30k this month.
anika: For customs, what's HS code vendor using? We need consistent classification to avoid further hold.
vendor-liaison: HS 8471.50.80, plus commercial invoice amendment filed 10m ago. Forwarder says customs acknowledged amendment but photo inspection scheduled.
sanjay: Routing question — if we split air for immediate demand and sea for rest, which cluster gets which? FRA_dc has 12 live, 16 planned. Prioritize 12 for air+4 DOA replacements, rest by sea.
josh: Also confirm whether we can ship replacements to AMS edge pool instead (lower customs friction). Vendor?
vendor-liaison: AMS diversion possible but adds two days transit. We can re-route 10/20 to AMS if Redwood issues diversion by EOD.
rma-bot: RMA 2026-778 created, status: pending-photos. Please upload depot photos to the ticket within 72 hours to avoid holdback.
maria: Ops action: we'll approve 90% vendor pre-credit + redwood AWB expedite for 20 units. Sanjay pls confirm diversion to AMS by EOD if you want it.
sanjay: Confirm diversion to AMS for 10 units; proceed with air for remaining 10 to FRA and sea top-up. Sanjay: I'll coordinate depot photo upload and mark ticket 2026-778 as awaiting evidence.
anika: Noted — I'll add HS code and amended invoice to the ticket and ping customs contact.
josh: Final ask to vendor-liaison: send a one-line SLA for replacement transit + confirmation of 90% credit and AWB charging account (PO/INV ref) so finance can pre-authorize.
vendor-liaison: Sending SLA snippet now: "20 air replacements dispatched within 48h of pre-credit confirmation; 90% credit for DOA serials issued upon pre-authorization; remaining 10% after depot photo verification; AWB billed to Redwood account REF: RDW-PO-4422"
maria: Thanks. Ops will process pre-credit and AWB. I'll update procurement ledger after vendor invoice. :thumbsup:
